messages:
incidentbot: [ALERT] prod-inference - 5xx spike (service: inference-runtime) - 2024-09-12 14:12 UTC - 2m average 5xx: 4.8% > threshold 1%

Dina: i'm on it — paging @mohan for handoff if needed. grabbing traces and recent routing config.

Mohan: oncall available, give me a quick summary.

Dina: quick summary: spike started ~14:04 UTC, tail latencies and 5xx correlate with a burst of long prompts from one customer (AtlasAI). seeing high KV cache miss rate and repeated retries leading to throttling. not an OOM but backend requeues.

Elaine: CS reporting customers seeing errors and timeouts. i have a short notification draft below, hold to confirm technical mitigation first.

Samir: if the theory is KV pressure + retries, we can temporarily route AtlasAI to a quantized variant and lower concurrency for them. that should reduce memory pressure and batch size.

Dina: i'm going to apply a soft fallback routing to rwd-small-quant8 now. command: 

```bash
redwoodctl routing set --customer AtlasAI --model rwd-small-quant8 --policy soft-fallback
```

deploy-bot: routing change applied (id rchg-20240912-001).

Dina: monitoring after routing change — 5xx dropping from ~4.8% to 0.6% within a few minutes. will keep watch for any regressions.

incidentbot: STATUS UPDATE - Incident acknowledged; mitigation applied. Severity: partial degradation -> partial recovery.

Elaine: draft customer notification (internal copy):

"Hi AtlasAI team,

We observed elevated errors and delays for text-generation endpoints on 2024-09-12 starting at ~14:04 UTC. We've applied a temporary routing workaround that reduced errors; we are continuing to monitor. We're working on a full RCA and will follow up with timeline and preventative steps. If you need immediate assistance or want us to pause traffic, let us know.

— Redwood Inference Support"

Dina: suggest status page text: \"Partial service degradation for text-generation endpoints affecting a subset of customers; temporary routing applied. Users may see elevated errors or latency. Mitigation in progress; next update in 30m.\"

Samir: LGTM for status page. @elaine please hold on outbound customer email until we confirm impact window.

Dina: timeline (from traces):
- 14:04:12 UTC burst of long prompts from AtlasAI begins
- 14:06:03 UTC KV cache miss rate spikes; tail latencies increase
- 14:08:37 UTC retries and requeue count increase (service throttles start to trigger)
- 14:09:20 UTC routing fallback applied to quantized variant
- 14:13:00 UTC 5xx rate reduced to baseline (~0.6%)
- 14:25:00 UTC overall latencies returned to normal for most requests

Dina: logs (snippet):

```json
{"ts":"2024-09-12T14:07:02Z","svc":"runtime","err":"kvcache-miss","ctx":"reqid=abc123","lat_ms":512}
{"ts":"2024-09-12T14:08:41Z","svc":"runtime","err":"retry-limit","ctx":"reqid=def456","lat_ms":1302}
```

Elaine: sent internal cs note to AtlasAI (we will wait 30m and then send external update if metrics hold). copy of outbound message: 

"Hello AtlasAI, we observed a service disruption affecting some requests between ~14:04-14:13 UTC, with higher-than-normal latencies persisting until ~14:25 UTC. A temporary routing change was applied to mitigate impact. We will share an RCA and preventive actions by Monday. Apologies for the disruption."

Mohan: proposed preventive actions (initial):
1) per-customer concurrency caps (soft limit + hard throttle)
2) KV prefetch heuristic for long prompt sizes
3) automatic reroute to quantized/low-memory variants on sustained KV miss signals
4) add alert rule for sustained KV miss rate > 1% for >2m

Dina: agreed. i'll add runbook steps for manual routing fallback and add a checklist to verify concurrency caps after rollout.

Elaine: question for the RCA: what exact user-facing window do we state? Dina, based on traces, you recommend errors between 14:04-14:13 and elevated latency until 14:25.

Dina: yes. recommended customer wording: "User-facing errors observed between 14:04–14:13 UTC; increased response latencies continued up to 14:25 UTC for some requests."

Samir: i'll draft the RCA summary and include mitigation command + telemetry graphs. Also recommend we schedule a small follow-up with AtlasAI to walk through the planned throttling and routing changes.

incidentbot: NOTE - oncall handoff at 14:50 UTC to Mohan. Added to post-incident checklist: timeline verification, runbook update, customer follow-up scheduling.

Dina: runbook edits in progress (section: \"manual routing fallback\", \"eviction thresholds\", \"per-customer concurrency limits\").

Elaine: thanks team — i'm marking this as resolved (monitoring). we'll convert this thread into a postmortem doc with timeline, root cause (KV cache pressure from concentrated long-prompt burst causing retries and cascading throttles), and the preventative actions above.

Samir: +1. i'll attach graphs and the mitigation snippet to the postmortem draft.

Dina: closing out here. ping me if you need more traces or request ids for the RCA. :white_check_mark:

Elaine: thanks everyone :rocket:
